lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's HARC hearing on the Carhenge redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — three separate large-scale public hearings covering eight new buildings in Backman Village, and the public can weigh in. Thursday's joint Planning Commission and BOCC work session also deserves attention, with county staff and commissioners working through proposed Land Use Code amendments on forestry, oil and gas, deep geothermal, and condominium plats. Sprinkled through the week are fair board prep meetings and the Hardrock Hundred gets underway Friday.
